title: Mean under coordinate polarization
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, and choose any coordinate $i$. Form a new function that, at inputs with coordinate $i$ equal to $+1$, takes the maximum of the values of $f$ with coordinate $i$ set to either sign, and at inputs with coordinate $i$ equal to $-1$, takes the minimum of those two values. The resulting function has the same mean as $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
